method_name: ChemTS-style RNN-guided Monte Carlo tree search
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: UCT exploration-exploitation scores over a dynamically expanded prefix tree
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline next-token model training plus online backpropagation of observed rewards into prefix visit counts and values
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: upper-confidence prefix selection, prior-guided token expansion, and recurrent rollouts to de novo terminal SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES prefixes with a frozen recurrent chemical-language prior

applicability_conditions: The repair is supported when incomplete or canonical-invalid rollouts arise from newly expanded leaves while another expandable prefix-tree branch remains. Both rejection types occurred on every evaluated objective, and closing 2,005 such leaves still allowed all 145 announced adaptive batches to be filled.

The evidence supports immediate permanent exclusion of the failed expanded leaf under the inherited frozen-prior UCT implementation: dead children are omitted from later selection, and every candidate task completed its 300-call, batch-10 session without approaching the 2,500-rollout guard (observed per-batch maximum 75).

The causal scope is tightly isolated because the formal candidate differs from the Parent by only the two dead assignments, while the prior, RNG seeding, selection score, expansion and rollout rules, backup, novelty filters, and protocol remain unchanged.

The repair does not close leaves that generate valid duplicates of evaluated, previously emitted, or same-batch molecules. The screening run had a small number of evaluated collisions but no resulting stall, so evidence does not establish recovery when valid-duplicate collisions dominate batch construction.
The repair does not claim to recover a genuinely exhausted prefix tree with no alternative expandable branch; that condition was not observed in the completed candidate sessions.
Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and the five frozen benchmark objectives; reliability under the independent search seeds is not established by this node.

observable_measurements.name: failed_rollout_leaf_closure_rate
observable_measurements.parent_value: Parent n-ad8b380d9b4e had no dead assignment in either failed-rollout rejection branch: lines 810-818 increment invalid_rollouts and immediately continue, leaving the newly expanded leaf's default dead field false. Thus its explicit failed-leaf closure rate was 0.0 wherever these branches ran. The 39 completed Parent suggestion rounds logged 216 canonical-invalid terminals and 133 incomplete rollouts, while their five subsequent attempts were unclassified because the diagnostic was after the exception. Those attempts each reached the 2,500-rollout guard and raised after returning only 8/10 molecules for deco_hop, 9/10 for drd2_docking, 9/10 for median_2, 7/10 for sitagliptin_mpo, and 7/10 for zaleplon_mpo; summary.json consequently reports all five task sessions buggy after only 50-120 oracle calls.
observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 across all five task sessions produced 145 complete adaptive suggestion batches, 29 per task. Their suggestion records count 1,228 canonical-invalid completed terminals and 777 incomplete rollouts, for 2,005 qualifying failed rollouts. Candidate source lines 810-820 route every such event through exactly one of the two registered rejection branches; in each branch the newly expanded trace leaf first has invalid_rollouts incremented and is then unconditionally assigned dead = True before continue. Because _generate_trace obtains trace.path[-1] as the newly expanded child and _select_child excludes every dead child at lines 618-624, the source-and-log closure audit is 2,005/2,005 = 1.0. The seeded formal replay also traversed beyond every Parent failure point: the formerly missing next batches were returned as 10/10 at round 11 for zaleplon_mpo (13 raw rollouts) and deco_hop (18), round 5 for drd2_docking (28) and sitagliptin_mpo (18), and round 12 for median_2 (22). It then returned 10/10 in every remaining round; the maximum for any candidate batch was 75 raw rollouts, no task log contains the wrong-size RuntimeError, and summary.json reports status ok with 300 oracle calls for every task and 1,500 total calls.
